company_name: Foundation for Promotion of Material Science&Technology of Japan
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in material characterization and analysis techniques critical for semiconductor development and quality control.
summary: Foundation for Promotion of Material Science & Technology of Japan provides advanced analysis and evaluation services for new materials, focusing on semiconductor and related device characterization.
